requirements.text: 2–8 years of full stack engineering experience building consumer-facing products, with ownership across frontend and backend development.
Experience at a venture-backed startup or established technology company with rigorous engineering standards.
Proficiency in React, Next.js, and Python.
A computer science degree from a top-30 U.S. program.
A working understanding of AI models, particularly computer vision and recommendation systems.

We’re seeking a Full Stack Engineer who brings technical depth, strong product instincts, and an eye for exceptional user experiences. You’ll own features from concept through launch, build infrastructure that supports rapid growth, and turn advanced AI capabilities into products people love using.
The ability to navigate ambiguity, take initiative, and deliver within a small, fast-moving team.
Genuine enthusiasm for consumer products and working closely with users.
Experience scaling products in social media, commerce, lifestyle, or other consumer technology categories.
Swift or native iOS development experience.
Familiarity with image processing, data pipelines, ranking algorithms, or personalization.
Experience using A/B testing and customer insights to guide product decisions.
